build_cam_rot_mat: build a camera rotation matrix from camera positions and optional object center coordinates
create_AutoEncoder: create an AutoEncoder model with pose encoder, geometry decoder, and relight decoder for hand rendering
run_AutoEncoder_forward: run the AutoEncoder forward pass with pose, camera, and light tensors to render hand images
create_OLATRGBDecoder: create an OLATRGBDecoder with encoder-decoder layers for relighting primitives with shadow and view direction features
run_OLATRGBDecoder_forward: run the OLATRGBDecoder forward pass to compute relit primitive RGB from light positions and intensities
